Minimize a scalar function of one or more variables

Source: R/scipy_optimize.R
scipy_optimize_minimize.Rd

Port of jax.scipy.optimize.minimize. Supported methods are "BFGS" and "l-bfgs-experimental-do-not-rely-on-this" (case insensitive). The whole optimization is one lax_while_loop(), so the function can be wrapped in jit() and mapped with vmap().

Usage

scipy_optimize_minimize(
  fun,
  x0,
  args = list(),
  method,
  tol = NULL,
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

fun

Objective fun(x, ...) returning a scalar; x is a 1-D array.

x0

Initial guess (1-D).

args

List of extra arguments passed to fun after x.

method

Solver name.

tol

Ignored (as in JAX); use the solver options.

options

Named list of solver options.

Value

A scipy_optimize_OptimizeResults() list.

Details

Options for BFGS: maxiter (default 200 * length(x0)), norm (order of the gradient norm, default Inf), gtol (default 1e-5), line_search_maxiter (default 10). Status codes: 0 converged, 1 maxiter reached, 2 + the line search status if the line search failed, -1 otherwise.

Options for L-BFGS: maxiter, norm, maxcor (history size, default 10), ftol, gtol, maxfun, maxgrad, maxls (line search iterations, default 20).
